exposure: local evidence-based guidelines for early onset sepsis (EOS) risk assessment
web-based EOS calculator (applied with 0.6/1000 and 2/1000 EOS incidence rates)
cohort: Newborns born at >=34 weeks gestation admitted to an inner-city NICU between January 1, 2016, and December 31, 2017.
finding: The Early Onset Sepsis (EOS) calculator was helpful in optimizing antibiotic use, though its effectiveness was dependent on local EOS incidence, and local antibiotic stewardship guidelines demonstrated comparable antibiotic utilization reductions, particularly in the latter part of the study period.
